messages.subject: Announcing sklearn-pystan
parts:
scikit-learn is a python library for all sorts of statistics and machine learning work. One thing I like about it is the ease with which things like parameter searches and cross-validation can be implemented. I had been using it (manually) to do some model checking of Stan models, and have recently created a new library here:

https://github.com/rgerkin/pystan-sklearn

to illustrate how this can be done in a slightly more formal way. Unfortunately it requires some manual implementation for each model (I don't have an automated way to extract from the Stan model how goodness-of-fit should be scored, for example), but that's a small price to pay if you are going to run a big batch fit with a large number of parameters and want to do it efficiently.

Let me know if you all have any ideas for how this could be made better, faster, cleaner, or if this is even useful to anyone else.

Rick
